title.narrative: Enhance access to WASH services for affected people in Deir-ez-Zor through the rehabilitation and expansion of water infrastructure

description.narrative: ltpgtltbrgtThe proposed intervention in Jazaret Elbuhmeid, located in the Deir-ez-Zor governorate, aims to address the chronic water crisis affecting conflict-impacted populations by rehabilitating the town’s main water station. This effort will directly benefit approximately 19,171 individuals, including both host communities and displaced populations residing in nearby informal settlements and camps. The intervention will enhance access to safe drinking water, reduce reliance on costly and unsafe water trucking, and promote healthier living conditions through improved water infrastructure and public health safeguards.ltbrgtThe project will be implemented under the WASH sector through an integrated and multi-layered approach:ltbrgt The project will restore and upgrade the existing water station by installing a water pump with an intake system, establishing a new water line to transfer raw water from the river to the storage units, and improving the station’s disinfection and filtration capabilities. These actions will mitigate health risks associated with waterborne diseases and significantly reduce household spending on water.ltbrgt In addition, the project contributes to local recovery by improving essential services and creating operational sustainability through the, maintenance training for local technicians, and the re-establishment of water governance systems in coordination with local authorities.ltbrgtThe project seeks to:ltbrgt Ensure equitable access to safe and affordable water for vulnerable households, particularly those affected by displacement and poverty.ltbrgt Improve public health and hygiene conditions by reducing contamination and environmental risks caused by unregulated tanker water use.ltbrgt Build resilience and self-reliance through the rehabilitation of critical infrastructure and community engagement in operations and maintenance.ltbrgt Reduce the economic burden on families, who currently spend up to $50/month on water trucking, by providing sustainable and cost-efficient water supply solutions.ltbrgt Awareness raising for the community through awareness campaigns including water conservation and important of tariff collections.ltbrgtThe project will be carried out in close coordination with local authorities, WASH cluster partners, and community representatives to ensure alignment with humanitarian priorities and long-term sustainability. Moreover, training sessions will build local capacity to maintain the rehabilitated station, ensuring continued service delivery beyond the project period.ltbrgtBy integrating humanitarian response, this project will provide life-sustaining water access while also contributing to community stabilization and resilience in Jazaret Elbuhmeid. It offers a critical step forward in restoring dignity, improving living conditions, and laying the groundwork for durable recovery in one of Syria’s most underserved and vulnerable areas.ltbrgtlt/pgt
